messages:
Alana: Hey team — quick design review request. Screenshot and a short prototype in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/spend-rail-proto :eyes:
Mike: Saw it, looks promising. My main worry is density — when you show org + project toggles side-by-side the sparkline + token breakdown feels cramped on 1366px width. Can we collapse token legend into a hover panel?
Jess: Hover panels are hard for keyboard users / a11y. Prefer an accessible toggle that expands inline. Also copy change: 'Token split' -> 'Token breakdown by route' for clarity.
Tom: Agree with Jess on keyboard. Maybe default to collapsed on narrow widths and provide a show/hide chevron that is focusable and has aria-expanded.
Alana: Good call. How about compact rows with a chevron; on expand the token table slides down. Keeps initial density but accessible.
Mike: That works. Two caveats: (1) invoices link should be persistent at row-level (not inside expand) because customers expect quick download; (2) if a project has 0 spend we should de-emphasize but still keep link.
Sara: Copy nit: 'Download invoice' -> 'Download invoice (CSV)' when CSV only. If we support PDF later that can be 'Download invoice ▾' with a small caret.
Jess: Chart accessibility: ensure color palette passes 4.5:1 for contrast and add pattern fills for token categories for colorblind folks.
Tom: On the sparkline axis — consider removing gridlines by default and add hover tooltip with exact token counts. Gridlines add clutter at small sizes.
Alana: UX question: org vs project switch location. Current placement is top-left under header. Some PMs want it closer to the spend tiles filter. Thoughts?
Mike: Place it near primary filters (time range) — users think scope is a primary filter. Keep it above the tiles so it persists while scrolling.
Jess: If it stays sticky, ensure screen readers get the live region update when scope changes so focus doesn't jump unexpectedly. 
Sara: Tiny microcopy: 'All projects' -> 'Organization: All projects' to avoid ambiguity when people manage multiple orgs.
design-bot: Mock updated: https://figma.com/file/abc123/spend-rail-proto?node-id=42 :thumbsup:
Tom: Quick CSS snippet for the chevron button we discussed: `button.chev { background: none; border: 0; padding: 6px; } /* ensure :focus-visible outline */`
Mike: For token breakdown sorting — default to 'peak tokens' desc, but allow hover column sort. Keep sorts per-user (persist in localStorage).
Alana: Outstanding items: (1) implement inline expand with aria-expanded; (2) update copy to 'Token breakdown by route' + invoice copy; (3) adjust color palette and patterns; (4) move scope toggle near time range and make sticky. Can owners please ack?
Jess: ACK — I'll push color/pattern proposals by EOD and add live region notes to the spec.
Tom: ACK — I'll add the chevron interaction and keyboard behaviors to the dev spec.
Mike: ACK — will prototype sticky scope toggle with mock scroll behavior in Figma.
Sara: ACK — I'll update microcopy and invoice label variations in the copy doc.
Alana: Thanks all. If no hot takes by EOD tomorrow I'll move this to the next design sprint. :wave:
